title: Britons Celebrate New Powerball $1 Million Prize
seoTitle: Britons Celebrate New Powerball $1 Million Prize
subtitle: Second Match 5 Prize Hits UK as Jackpot Continues to Climb
excerpt: A second UK player won a $1 million Powerball prize, boosting interest in the lottery, which now boasts a $332 million jackpot.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
This week's Powerball highlight comes from a second UK winner who received $1 million by matching five numbers. This reinforces attention to the game, which has just reached a $332 million jackpot.

How the British Player's Winning Draw Works

In the September 21 draw, the winning white numbers were 2, 7, 9, 17, and 58, and the red Powerball was 20. The Power Play multiplier was 2x. To win the jackpot, players would have needed to match all six numbers.

Smaller Prizes Awarded Across the US and UK

Although the jackpot wasn't won, 14 players matched four white numbers plus the Powerball, receiving prizes of $50,000 or $100,000, depending on the Power Play. The $1 million prize was awarded to those who matched only the five white numbers, without the Powerball.

Jackpot Grows Ahead of Next Draw

With no winner for the top prize, the accumulated amount rose to $332 million, setting the stage for next Wednesday's draw. A hypothetical winner could choose between the full annuity or the $141.7 million cash option.

Other Recent Winners in the United States

In the same week, a player in New York received $1 million by matching the five white numbers. Additionally, weeks prior, Powerball paid out two Match 5 prizes: $1 million in Georgia and $2 million in Ohio. A $3 million ticket was also sold in Pennsylvania, awaiting its winner.

Impact of Powerball's Presence in the UK

The game was launched in the UK earlier this year, allowing Britons to compete for the same unlimited jackpot as North American participants. The second Match 5 prize recorded in the country demonstrates the lottery's rapid adoption among local players.

With information from Gambling News.
